evidenceBoundary.exact: Four complete current bulk-selection blocks and the actual REP target entry through RET, authenticated against current native inputs and parent full bulk window.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Actual entry sets the destination return value; unsigned size/mode, source/destination overlap and shared byte-option branches reach a leaf that saves RSI/RDI, forwards byte-copy operands to REP MOVSB, restores the registers and returns.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: Mode dword and option byte are anonymous runtime selection cells; neither their provider names nor current values are established.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Parent same-element copy selections, runtime Vector3 stride equal to the separately checked twelve-byte width, REP-selected length/mode/option, DF=0, valid stable non-wrapping memory, forward-safe overlap, disjoint caller frame and optional bitset, normal completion and successful optional bitset retry.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Other small/snapshot/vector/non-temporal/backward branches, observed DF/mode/option/array stride, allocation and alias lifetimes, general old-value preservation across resize, renderer and parent lifetime joins, and actual execution.
